title: Resources card interaction polish
eyebrow: Web + native iOS · Wisconsin Creative · Resources
lede: Web guide cards and the native iOS Guides row are now title-first surfaces: type and status remain as small orientation cues, while preview text and ownership metadata stay in the guide.

stats.n: Same source-equivalent fixture, data, viewport, pointer position, and card geometry
Hovered title-first guide card bounds remain unchanged between baseline and refinement
After state moves only the guide chevron 2px and removes the whole-card shadow

sections.heading: Hovered guide card
sections.note: The pair uses the same five title-first guide cards and two reference shortcuts. The pointer is held over Photo Naming & Organization Guide in both captures; only the hover treatment changes.

pairs.title: A library card should not become a raised panel
pairs.sub: Look at the Photo Naming & Organization Guide card in the All guides section. Both states keep the title and small type cue visible; the baseline elevates the entire surface, while the refinement keeps it stable and reserves motion for the directional cue. The native iOS list row follows the same title-first content hierarchy.
pairs.beforeCap: Before: the hovered guide card changes its border and adds a visible shadow across the whole card.
pairs.afterCap: After: the card surface stays quiet; its chevron supplies the small navigation response while the reference rows retain their action hover.

changesNote: This is an interaction hierarchy correction, not a removal of feedback. Focus rings and 0.96 press feedback remain on the existing actions; reference shortcuts still have a subtle action hover.

changes.h: Guide cards carried too much secondary content
changes.was: Each guide card surfaced a Markdown preview, visibility/audience labels, author, and date alongside the title, making the library feel closer to a content feed than a quick-reference index.
changes.now: Web guide cards and the native iOS Guides row are title-first surfaces. Small type/status cues remain for orientation, while preview text, visibility/audience labels, author names, and dates are left to the guide reader.

changes.h: Every guide card announced hover at the container level
changes.was: Guide cards and list rows changed border color and added a shadow whenever the pointer entered any part of the link, making every library tile feel like a raised control.
changes.now: Guide surfaces keep their border and shadow quiet on hover. The existing link remains fully interactive and adds a restrained chevron cue near the title.

changes.h: Non-actionable contact cards implied a whole-card action
changes.was: Contact cards used the same border/shadow hover treatment even though the card itself is a layout container around individual contact links and a View profile action.
changes.now: Contact cards are visually quiet; the individual fields and profile action retain their own interaction targets.

changes.h: The remaining card cues needed a quieter hierarchy
changes.was: Type icons and small status/category cues blended into the card content, while the broad hover state carried too much of the visual hierarchy.
changes.now: Type icons use a quiet bordered treatment, small type/status cues stay compact, and the guide title receives a little more identity without adding a new semantic color.

verification: 11 focused Resources tests and 45 focused iOS contract tests pass, including the quiet-card/local-affordance and title-first content source contracts.
TypeScript and lint: full npm run lint and npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false pass.

Repository and iOS static checks: migration-prefix validation, git diff --check, npm run codemap:check, npm run verify:docs, npm run ios:project:check, npm run drift:ios, and npm run audit:ios:gaps pass.
Native build: the Wisconsin app target builds for the available iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5 simulator.

Matched fixture measurement: the hovered title-first card remains 320 × 128px; baseline computes a #666 border and 0 4px 12px shadow, while the refined state computes the quiet #272727 border, no shadow, and a 2px chevron translation.

Authenticated in-app browser: the real local /resources route rendered at 1428 × 1153 and 390 × 844; guide-link DOM text contains only title plus type/status cues, and the hovered card has no shadow or underline while its local chevron translates 2px.
notes: The paired images are a source-equivalent static fixture captured through the in-app browser. They isolate the exact hover change without presenting a different data set as a baseline; authenticated runtime captures are saved beside them.

Authenticated local desktop and narrow proof confirmed title-only guide surfaces and the restrained hover response. Native iOS source/build proof confirms the list-row contract; a native simulator visual walkthrough was not performed in this slice. Production deployment and production read-back remain separate gates; no production data was changed.
The dev server was launched with the preview database environment and an in-process development session secret; repository env files were not modified.
